sources: The Block, Nov 21 2026: NY AG Letitia James seeks a TRO in New York County Supreme Court (Justice Melissa Crane), hearing Monday 11:30 a.m. ET; order would bar Kalshi from operating an unlicensed gambling business 'within or from New York or to persons in New York', users under 21, college campus ads; Kalshi lawyer Sean Murphy (Milbank): would 'shut down a federally regulated exchange for every customer, everywhere', likely force liquidation of all open positions; James's office: does not seek to shut the exchange for all customers everywhere; Judge Lorna Schofield denied CFTC's second emergency request Nov 20; 4th, 6th, 9th Circuits sided with states, 3rd Circuit with Kalshi

Reuters via Investing.com, Nov 20 2026: Schofield rejected CFTC emergency bid, CFTC 'not established a likelihood of success on the merits'; three federal appeals courts say states can regulate Kalshi, a fourth said New Jersey could not, making Supreme Court review more likely; case returned to state court the day before; state judge to hear James's request Monday
The Block, Jul 31 2026 + Wealth Professional / Al Jazeera Jul 31: New York sued Kalshi, seeking $36 billion in damages; Kalshi called it 'political theater'
